items.t: The Countdown Is On! TME live Teams Up with BIGBANG to Bring the COSMOS Universe to Life Across Hong Kong
items.sum: Presented by TME live and ELF ASIA, with FWD Insurance, Visa, Trip.com Group, Klook and Samsung as joint sponsors, BIGBANG 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR IN HONG KONG will take the stage at Kai Tak Stadium, Hong Kong, China, on November 13, 14, 15 and 17. Tickets sold out almost immediately after going on sale, with the exclusive priority pre-sale for SVIP users on TME's QQ Music, JOOX and Kugou Music.
